itinerary: Day 1: Arrival at Islamabad airport, hotel and evening briefing
Day 2: Drive Islamabad to Chilas via Karakoram Highway (10-12 hrs)
Day 3: Drive Chilas to Karimabad (Hunza) via Gilgit
Day 4: Drive to Minapin, trek to Hapakun (5.8km, 4-5 hrs)
Day 5: Trek Hapakun to Tagaphari/Rakaposhi Base Camp 3,300m
Day 6: Excursion to Diran Base Camp across glaciers (3-4 hrs)
Day 7: Trek to Katchelly Lake 4,000m, return to camp
Day 8: Trek back to Minapin, drive to Karimabad
Day 9: Buffer day; Hunza Valley sightseeing and shopping
Day 10: Drive to Chilas via Karakoram Highway
Day 11: Drive Chilas to Islamabad (10-12 hrs)
Day 12: Transfer to Islamabad airport
pros: Full 12-day Islamabad-to-Islamabad package with domestic flights included
All meals, beverages and water covered throughout
Extras most rivals skip: satellite phone, first aid kit, achievement certificate
Built-in Day 9 buffer for weather/delays
Extra Katchelly Lake (4,000m) day beyond the standard base camp
cons: Long itinerary with only ~4 trekking days among 12 total
Requires special trekking visa, not standard tourist visa
Personal equipment (shoes, jackets) not provided
Tips and insurance excluded
verdict: A comprehensive 12-day guided package with strong inclusions (flights, meals, sat phone, buffer day) for travellers wanting everything arranged from Islamabad. Best for those who value logistics and safety extras over a quick budget trek.
excludes: Insurance, international airfare, visa fees, personal equipment, extra hotel nights, tips, miscellaneous and Force Majeure costs.

itinerary: Day 1: Islamabad airport welcome and city tour
Day 2: Drive Islamabad to Chilas via Babusar Pass (~10-11 hrs)
Day 3: Drive to Minapin with three-ranges junction stop
Day 4: Trek Minapin to Hapakun base camp 2,814m (4-5 hrs)
Day 5: Trek to Rakaposhi base camp 3,261m, Tagaphari meadow
Day 6: Excursion to Diran Peak Base Camp 3,650m, return
Day 7: Trek down to Minapin, drive to Karimabad

Day 10: Drive back to Naran via Babusar Pass
Day 11: Drive to Islamabad with museum visit

pros: Multiple durations offered (12, 14 or 15 days) for flexible planning
Trek plus full Hunza cultural circuit (forts, lakes, Passu glaciers)
Domestic flights and camping equipment included
Specific altitude figures given for each base camp
cons: Trekking is only ~3-4 days of a long 12+ day trip
Sleeping bags not included (must bring/rent)
Single room supplement charged extra
Insurance and gratuities excluded
verdict: A flexible-length package pairing the Rakaposhi/Diran trek with a thorough Hunza sightseeing loop, suited to travellers wanting culture plus trekking rather than a fast summit-and-back. Choose the 12-day option for the leanest version.
excludes: International airfare, visas, personal insurance, gratuities, single room supplements, sleeping bags and personal expenses.

Day 2: Hapakun to Rakaposhi Base Camp Taghaphari 3,500m, camp

Starts/ends at Gilgit, low time commitment
All camping gear, meals and porters included
Beginner- and family-friendly with optional guesthouse stay
Optional Diran Base Camp extension available
cons: Emergency evacuation explicitly not covered
No travel insurance included
Personal equipment and gear rentals not provided
Extra nights beyond program cost extra
verdict: The genuine quick-and-direct Rakaposhi Base Camp trek (3 days from Gilgit), ideal for beginners, families or anyone time-constrained. Best value if you only want the trek itself without a Hunza tour wrapper.
excludes: Personal equipment/supplies, travel insurance and emergency evacuation, additional nights outside the program, and extra gear rentals.

Day 3: Drive to Karimabad Hunza, sunset at Eagles Nest

pros: 11-night/12-day package adding Khunjerab Pass and upper Hunza
Visa invitation letters and route maps provided
Porters, cook and entrance fees included
Rich cultural/scenic add-ons (forts, glaciers, Attabad Lake)
cons: Only ~2 days of actual trekking in a 12-day trip
Hotel meals not included (only trekking meals covered)
Alcoholic beverages and personal items excluded
Traveller bears extra costs for weather delays
verdict: A sightseeing-heavy 12-day tour where the Rakaposhi trek is one segment among many Hunza highlights including Khunjerab Pass. Good for a one-trip overview of northern Pakistan, less so for trek-focused visitors.
excludes: Early check-in/late checkout, hotel meals, alcohol, personal items, guide/porter tips and trip extensions.
